observations: All final sampled persistent sets contain seven live textures with 6,161,776 resident bytes and zero pooled bytes.
Present-only sampling stops at present 100 and does not establish the final idle state.
Settled sampling confirms zero retired persistent-pool bytes after scrolling. The explicit ledger is approximately 23.0 MiB; process GPU meters remain substantially higher.
Persistent RGBA8 page creation stays at five; the older snapshot’s persistent page churn is not reproduced here.
A constant-buffer upload prototype is being tested; these counters do not establish its cause or benefit.
limitations: Instrumentation allocates, queries DXGI and adds maintenance wakes, so it can change timing and driver allocation behavior.
The two sampling variants are grouped diagnostics and cannot establish a before/after improvement.
DXGI sampled usage and the external dedicated-GPU counter are taken at different times and cover different accounting details.
Original shared-checkout git rows in harness manifests do not identify the measured snapshot; source-manifest.json and instrumentation.json do.
